note: Requirements are quoted from the sources. 'Site status' says what this site does today. 'Needs review' items are on the Flagged for Review page.

rows.requirement: Display 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' clearly and prominently on the site.
rows.section: Operating Agreement, Section 5 'Identifying Yourself as an Associate'
rows.site_action: The banner shows this wording as the required statement and says enrollment is pending. It must not be presented as active until the Associates account is confirmed.

rows.requirement: Special Links must include the Associates ID or 'tag' as a parameter in the URL of each link.
rows.site_action: The supplied links contain no tag. No tag has been invented. See F03.

rows.requirement: Prices and availability may be shown only if the Amazon link serves them, or if they come from the Creators API or PA-API.
rows.site_action: No prices or availability are shown. The price column is blank.

rows.requirement: Product lists require additional original content on the site.
rows.site_action: The category page adds original analysis, a verification table and a glossary of what was and was not verified.

rows.requirement: Sites must not include any Amazon trademark in the domain name, subdomain, tag or Associates ID.
rows.site_action: The domain is kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone1, which contains no Amazon mark. The word 'Amazon' appears only in running text and in source names.

rows.requirement: Purchases referred by a 'Redirecting Link' (a link that sends users indirectly to an Amazon Site through an intermediate site) are disqualified.
rows.site_action: The supplied links are link.amazon short links. Whether they count as Special Links is not confirmed. See F05.

rows.requirement: A non-US Associate agrees to perform services outside the United States unless the tax information says otherwise.
rows.site_action: The site owner's location is Oslo, Norway. Confirm account status and tax information. Agreement Schedule 3 (taxes) was not reviewed. See F08.

rows.requirement: Commission income is a percentage of Qualifying Revenue, which excludes shipping, gift wrap, handling, taxes, service charges, credits, rebates and card-processing fees.
rows.site_action: No commission amounts are estimated, because the rate is unverified (F02).

rows.requirement: Do not make public communications about the Associates Program beyond the required disclosure without written permission.
rows.site_action: The site describes its own verification work but does not describe the Associates relationship beyond the disclosure. Owner to confirm.

rows.requirement: Material connections must be disclosed clearly, near the endorsement, and in a way that is hard to miss.
rows.section: FTC Disclosures 101, 'When to Disclose' and 'How to Disclose'
rows.site_action: A disclosure banner sits at the top of every page, above any product listing.

rows.requirement: Do not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or misleading claims about a Product.
rows.site_action: Only specifications read from the title text are shown. No performance or health claims are made.
